Easy question out of the way first, don't go below 3/4" for a sturdy tabletop, anything thinner will bend over time with repeated beatings. If it's only for light work 1/2" can save you some money. Of course this is professionally speaking, for hobby welding 1/4" cold rolled can be just fine.

Now having read your comment below about dreading drilling holes, you have a few options.

  1. Rent a magnet drill for a day & get an annular cutting bit (core drill). Way more efficient than traditional drill bits as you only remove ~20% of the material and have multiple teeth in contact with the surface, no worries about not drilling straight unless you get crap underneath the electromagnet.

  2. Make a .dxf of the tabletop you want and get it lazer cut or plasma cut (plasma will require cleaning the holes a bit). Don't go through a steel supplier, deal directly with the cutting shop.
